whatWasDeclared.participantMustSupply: The name of the Arizona superior court this petition is filed in. No committed record this packet binds states a county venue rule - the committed track registry records venue only as "Statewide Arizona law; petition in superior court." - so the platform holds no value for it and this packet does not choose a county for you. Ask an Arizona superior court clerk which superior court takes a petition under A.R.S. § 13-4051 in your case, and write that court's name on this line before you file.
